difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the behaviour of pseudo-coherence along a distinguished triangle with one degree of slack (statement lines 12176-12187). The proof (proof lines 12189-12235) chooses strictly perfect witnesses for K and L on a covering with the appropriate degree shifts, lifts the maps to an actual commutative square of complexes on a refinement, takes the cone of the horizontal map (strictly perfect by the cone lemma), and compares the resulting morphism of triangles through the four and five lemmas to witness the pseudo-coherence of M; the other two parts follow by rotation. H2: one cone construction plus one comparison of long exact sequences, written out.
